**Part 1: IBM Think 2023 Introduction & AI Overview**
IBM Think 2023 kicked off with a discussion on AI-generated art and songs, highlighting the fun and engaging aspects of AI. However, when applied to big business, AI needs to be held to a higher standard. Dr. Dario Gil, IBM's Senior Vice President and Director of Research, emphasized that AI in business should be built to be trusted, secured, and adaptable. This isn't simple automation, but AI that works across an organization and is hybrid-ready, scalable, and transparent. Building AI into the core of your business can take you further, and IBM is here to help with AI for business.

**Part 2: IBM's AI Journey & WatsonX Platform**
IBM has had an exciting year in AI, with foundation models being the next big thing. Dr. Gil recapped IBM's AI accomplishments, including the announcement of WatsonX, a comprehensive platform for creating and governing AI in real-time. WatsonX consists of three primary parts: watsonx.data, watsonx.ai, and watsonx.governance, working together seamlessly throughout the entire lifecycle of foundation models. IBM also announced a family of foundation models, data and model factories, product integrations, collaborations, and hardware innovations like IBM Vela and IBM Research AIU.

**Part 3: Becoming an AI Value Creator with WatsonX**
To maximize the potential of AI, IBM encourages businesses to be AI value creators, not just users. With WatsonX, users can bring their own data and AI models, train and influence training, tune models, have transparency and control, and prompt models. The platform enables an end-to-end AI workflow, from data preparation to model deployment and continuous monitoring. IBM has partnered with Hugging Face to bring the power of the open AI community to WatsonX, further enhancing its capabilities.

**Part 4: IBM's Tips for Harnessing Foundation Models**
To successfully harness foundation models, IBM recommends acting with urgency, being a value creator, betting on community, optimizing for performance, and being responsible. This involves continuously governing data and AI, and co-creating with trusted partners. By following these tips, businesses can do amazing things with foundation models and generative AI using WatsonX as their guide.
